name: @comchatx/moonshotai
description: Moonshot AI in pi, through the ComChatX box's model proxy.
author: ComChatX

description.en:
Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's open-weights model for long documents and work that takes many steps.

Suitable for long Chinese or English documents and tasks that take several steps in sequence.
description.zh:
Kimi K3 是 Moonshot AI 的开放权重模型，适合处理长文档和需要很多步骤的工作。

适合处理中英文长文档，以及需要连续完成多个步骤的任务。
